messages.author: 6db62e08ec862130
messages.subject: a la carte includes
parts:
I notice that the include files have been split into scal/arr/mat
subdirectories. This mostly makes sense, but

+ is_vector_like generally requires get/length/value_of_rec

+ VectorView generally requires is_vector_like

Can we move is_vector_like and VectorView into a non-type-specific meta
directory? Otherwise it seems a bit silly to require a block of includes
like,

#include <stan/math/prim/scal/meta/length.hpp>
#include <stan/math/prim/scal/meta/is_vector_like.hpp>
#include <stan/math/prim/arr/meta/is_vector_like.hpp>
#include <stan/math/prim/arr/meta/length.hpp>
#include <stan/math/prim/arr/meta/get.hpp>
#include <stan/math/prim/mat/meta/get.hpp>

?

--

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] a la carte includes
parts:
Hi Joshua,

The first statements aren't true:

On Tue, Mar 10, 2015 at 9:31 AM, Joshua N Pritikin <jpri...@pobox.com> wrote:
I notice that the include files have been split into scal/arr/mat
subdirectories. This mostly makes sense, but

+ is_vector_like generally requires get/length/value_of_rec

+ VectorView generally requires is_vector_like
But, Rob and I have been thinking about the second part.

Can we move is_vector_like and VectorView into a non-type-specific meta
directory? Otherwise it seems a bit silly to require a block of includes
like,

#include <stan/math/prim/scal/meta/length.hpp>
#include <stan/math/prim/scal/meta/is_vector_like.hpp>
#include <stan/math/prim/arr/meta/is_vector_like.hpp>
#include <stan/math/prim/arr/meta/length.hpp>
#include <stan/math/prim/arr/meta/get.hpp>
#include <stan/math/prim/mat/meta/get.hpp>

?

I wanted to wait until the dust settled on this refactoring before breaking the hierarchy.
Where did you need to block it out in this way? I'm pretty sure you're including too much.



Daniel
